format: OSwind bounded audio privacy and shared Accessibility observations v1
scope: Synthetic contexts, PCM, permission/stream factories, local fake speech backends, owned encrypted/model runs and signed CLI/import/API/MCP/portability processes. No real microphone/system-audio capture, physical input, energy, AX latency or competitor acceptance.

implementation.IPCWorker: Shared utility worker, no process-wide AX timeout

newCoverage.sharedProducer: Two independent live consumers use one producer; cancelling one preserves the other; completed reads start a new producer; ninth observer refused
newCoverage.audio: Suspended startup/UI responsiveness; unknown/secure/excluded/stale identity; post-ASR stop/lock/settings/root replacement; no premature WAV; explicit finish; old queued-session rejection; three waiting chunks; recognizer-error recovery
newCoverage.directoryClose: Original moved connection closes without changing a separate replacement database/WAL/SHM; original source survives reopen

signedPackage.scope: Separately staged schema20 bounded audio privacy and shared AX observations; no installation or native capture/input acceptance

calendarProcess.scope: Owned synthetic imports and live CLI/HTTP/MCP counts; no capture, native input, energy or competitor claim.
checks: complete counts exceed search caps
CLI HTTP MCP identical metadata scopes
repeated clock hour distinct UTC ranges
23 hour DST day and leap month
inclusive start exclusive end
invalid relevance and malformed parameters rejected
HTTP token origin host guards
external writer visible to persistent HTTP connection

tagCompatibilityProcess.scope: Owned synthetic source/tag mutations, schema20 compatibility, exact search and quiet portability. No capture, normal history or credentials.
checks: schema20 upgrade preserves exact source payloads
duplicate tags count once; case stays exact
older writer insertion and replacement maintain projection
old JSON and new indexed searches agree
source metadata and tag rows match independent SQL JSON oracle
quiet backup restore rebuilds counts
JSON round trip rebuilds counts

domainPrivacyProcess.scope: Synthetic imported notes; domain/app/title filtering before admission and resulting CLI/HTTP/MCP consistency. No capture/device, retrospective text hiding or energy claim.
checks: root-dot, encoded, IDNA and configured domain spelling
case-insensitive app and title exclusions
CLI/HTTP/MCP search agree
excluded imports absent by direct HTTP/MCP id
owned stats preserve admission counts
HTTP token required

report.fixture: generated 2-second 16 kHz PCM; deterministic external ASR emits one timestamped segment
checks: CLI file preparation, timestamp/session persistence and keyword retrieval
crossing decoder segment ends clipped to independently measured source duration; wholly outside segments refused without partial admission
original clip retained privately, source never changed
detected secret suppresses complete raw clip and redacts both text representations
full media backup/restore preserves transcript/session and audio bytes
erasure removes owned clip only; malformed input fails
limits: mock ASR does not establish recognition quality

retainedDevelopmentCorrections.initialTestBuild: Async test static helper isolation and SearchHit.memory access corrected before final full/native/race runs
retainedDevelopmentCorrections.transientASRError: Scoped privacy error type keeps ordinary ASR failure from disabling allowed capture
retainedDevelopmentCorrections.restartTest: Wait for the new run to be active before releasing the old fake backend; avoids scheduling-dependent assertions
